$comment: Riftlight authored opening draft. Development preview only; see ../README.md. Production campaign id will be riftlight. No bonus XP: preserve the design bible campaign budget.
title: The Path Beside the River

plate.narration: The Great River runs beneath a narrow shelf of blue ice. Dark rock rises on one side; cold water slides along the other. Ahead, the path bends out of sight.

goal.text: Get everyone along the icy shelf to the cairns.

steps.label: Find a way past the broken ice

shelf.narration: The singing hall falls behind you. Ahead, a narrow shelf of ice runs beside the Great River toward Frostfang. Your job is to get everyone along this shelf, together, to the cairns. The herder's goats need that road. Orin said to test the ice. Old boot marks lead out, then stop where part of the shelf has fallen away.

lineup.narration: The shelf is only a few steps wide. The river hisses past its edge. You have a long rope. It smells a little like fish. How will you carry it? Orin would say carefully. Orin would also draw a diagram.

knots.narration: Everyone ties onto the rope. On ice, a knot that is almost right is a wrong knot. Every knot holds. The rope hums between you like a guitar string.

coil.narration: You shake the rope out and coil it again, loose and free. The loops sit in your hand like a sleeping snake. Anyone could throw them in a blink.

beat.narration: Rally is for nervous feet, too. You hum a low, slow tune. Step, step, hum. Soon even the Listening Chime swings in time, and the line stays loose and easy.

ring_thud.narration: Old boot marks follow the dark rock wall. The ice looks the same everywhere, white as a plate. Thick ice rings when you tap it. Thin ice thuds, like an empty drum. Somebody taps once. Ping! Now everybody has to try. How will you test it?

tap.narration: Tap, tap, tap. You walk bent over, like someone hunting for a lost button.
tap.prompt: Tell the ringing ice from the thudding ice.

onSuccess.narration: Ring, ring, thud. You keep to the ringing parts and give each thud a polite nod.

onFailure.narration: It all sounds half ring, half thud. You follow the old boot marks.

slide.narration: You find a flat stone the size of a cookie.
slide.prompt: Slide it ahead. Watch where it skids, sticks or sinks.

onSuccess.narration: The stone skates, stops and skates again. Now you can see the sound ice.

onFailure.narration: The stone skids off the edge. Plop. You test the rest with your boots.

scout.narration: Your wings catch the cold air. The shelf below is a long white ribbon.
scout.prompt: Find the pale, thin patches from above.

onSuccess.narration: Thin ice shows pale as old milk. You land on a safe line.

onFailure.narration: Up here, everything is white. You land and follow the boot marks.

starlight.narration: Starlight gathers in your hand. Thin ice drinks it. Thick ice bounces it back.
starlight.prompt: Find where the glow goes dim.

onSuccess.narration: The glow dims over three pale patches. You lead everyone around them.

onFailure.narration: The light flickers in the wind. You settle for the old boot marks.

boot_marks.narration: The boot marks bend toward the wall. There, a rusty iron ring is hammered into the rock, with a scrap of old rope still on it. Someone tied a line here long ago. Can you trust it?

ring_pull.narration: You take turns hanging on the ring. It does not budge. As the last hero lets go, a frozen glove drops out of a crack. Inside is a good bootlace. You pocket it and shake out a loop of rope. The ring needs to catch it.

ring_look.narration: Scratched into the rust is a tiny feather. Griffin keepers hung their lines here long ago. Tied to the ring is a little tin. The note inside says: For the next traveler. Under it lie three coins. You take them, then shake out a loop of rope for the ring.

squeeze.narration: Past the ring, the shelf pinches to one boot wide. Spray flicks your ankles. The packs are heavy, and the ice is slick as soap. Somebody says they are not scared. Their knees disagree. How will you get through?

inch.narration: You shuffle sideways along the cold wall. The river mutters by your ear.
inch.prompt: Shuffle along, one careful foot at a time.

onSuccess.narration: Slide, slide, rest. Nobody looks down.

onFailure.narration: A boot slips, and an elbow scrapes the rock. It stings, but the line holds.

packs.narration: You make a line and pass the heavy packs hand to hand.
packs.prompt: Pass every pack without dropping one.

onSuccess.narration: The packs travel like buckets at a well. In the last one is a supper bundle you forgot.

onFailure.narration: A pack drops and slides toward the edge. A boot stops it just in time.

chop.narration: Smash is good for more than doors. You crouch at the narrowest spot and swing.
chop.prompt: Chop a wide step for everyone.

onSuccess.narration: Crunch, crunch, crunch. Chunky steps appear, and everyone walks them.

onFailure.narration: Chips fly, and the step comes out crooked. You shuffle along it anyway.

wide_spot.narration: The shelf widens into a flat spot. You sit and shake out your wet cuffs. An icicle drips on somebody's hat, again and again, as if it has a message. Ahead, water chatters across the ice. How will you rest?

wide_snack.narration: You share half a flatbread, a cube of cheese and a tired apple, cut into extremely fair pieces. Your legs stop shaking. The chattering water sounds almost friendly.

wide_eat.narration: You unwrap a proper supper: bread, cheese and a sausage somebody swears is still warm. It is not. Everyone eats slowly. Your legs stop shaking, and your cheeks come back.

wide_look.narration: From here you can see far along the shelf. Water sparkles across the ice. Then comes a dark wall of icicles. Past that, the shelf seems to end in thin air. Now you know where the trouble is.

crack.narration: A stream of meltwater cuts across the shelf, in a crack as wide as a long stride. The water below is black and loud. The old boot marks jump it. Somebody peeks in. "Deep," they report. "Also wet."

hop.narration: You line up with your toes at the crack. Your knees agree to the plan, mostly.

onSuccess.narration: One, two, jump! Boots land in a row. The crack gurgles behind you.

onFailure.narration: Somebody lands short, elbows on the edge. Everyone grabs a sleeve and hauls them up, soggy.

slab.narration: A loose slab of ice, big as a door, lies by the wall. A fine bridge, if it moves.
slab.prompt: Drag the slab over the crack.

onSuccess.narration: The slab slides across with a grinding sigh. A wobbly, wonderful bridge.

onFailure.narration: The slab cracks and sinks. The bigger half stays up for two quick hops.

leap.narration: To you, the crack looks like a puddle with big plans.
leap.prompt: Leap over and tie the rope to the far rock.

onSuccess.narration: Thump! You tie off the rope, and the others follow it.

onFailure.narration: You land long and bonk the wall. The knot is wobbly, but it holds.

icicles.narration: Past the crack, a curtain of icicles hangs from the rock like upside-down candles. Some are longer than your arm. Now and then, one lets go. You all agree not to sneeze.

dash.narration: Plink. Plink. Plink-plink. Listen, and the drips have a rhythm. Plink, plink, gap!

knock.narration: A snowball is a small, round plan. Thwack. Crash. Tinkle. The long icicles fall in a glittering heap. Only small drips are left.

gust.narration: The shelf bends around a corner, and the wind finds you. It shoves. It whistles. It moves the snow off the rocks and onto your hat. How will you get through?

huddle.narration: Linked arms make a good wall, even a wall of slightly nervous people.
huddle.prompt: Lean in together and shuffle forward.

onSuccess.narration: The wind pushes. You push back. Nobody blows away, though one hat has to be chased.

onFailure.narration: A big gust makes you stagger. You wobble through in a laughing clump.

lull.narration: The wind comes in waves. Find the beat, and walk between them.
lull.prompt: Count the gusts and call when to move.

onSuccess.narration: One, two, three, gust. One, two, three, go!

onFailure.narration: You lose count. The wind steals a hat and a bit of pride.

sing.narration: The wind is loud, so you sing louder. It just has to be a long song.
sing.prompt: Lead a song that keeps everyone walking.

onSuccess.narration: Everyone joins in, and the wind loses interest.

onFailure.narration: The wind steals the tune. You hum the rest, teeth chattering.

slope.narration: Past the corner, a sheet of ice pours down from the rocks and across the shelf. It is steep as a playground slide, and it ends in the river. The old boot marks cross it in big, brave steps. How will you cross?

slope_steps.narration: A boot heel is a very small hammer. It cuts a very small stair.
slope_steps.prompt: Kick a step for every boot.

onSuccess.narration: Chop, chop, chop. Neat little steps, and everyone crosses.

onFailure.narration: The steps come out shallow. You cross on hands and toes, like nervous crabs.

slope_rope.narration: Rope loves holding on. You look for a lump of rock at each end.
slope_rope.prompt: Hitch the rope at both ends for a handrail.

onSuccess.narration: Loop, loop, tight. Everyone crosses hand over hand.

onFailure.narration: The first rock wobbles loose. You find a better one, and the handrail goes up crooked.

slope_slide.narration: Sliding is what ice does best. You decide to let it.
slope_slide.prompt: Slide across feet first, and steer for the snowdrift.

onSuccess.narration: Whoosh! You land one by one in a soft drift. Everyone wants another go.

onFailure.narration: Too fast! You hit the drift with a thump. There is a rock in it.

gap.narration: At last the boot marks stop. Part of the shelf has fallen away, too wide to step. Above, dark rocks climb in steps. Below, a lip of ice still touches both sides. A snowhorn goat on a ledge chews and watches you, unimpressed.

variants.text: On the far rock glints another rusty iron ring, like the one you trusted.
You saw this from the wide spot. It looks no better up close.

inspect.narration: High on the rocks, a goat track zigzags to the far side. Down low, the lip of ice touches both sides, but its outer edge is thin. Your rope can reach sound rock over there, if someone takes it. How will you make a way across?

high.narration: You climb onto the dark rocks. A loose stone rattles into the water. The goat watches, jaw going around like a slow millstone. Then it picks its way along a narrow track toward the far side. Will you follow it?

high_climb.narration: The goat does not hurry. It keeps looking back, as if to say: easy, really.
high_climb.prompt: Follow the goat's track with the rope.

onSuccess.narration: Up goes your climber, light as a cat. The loop drops over the far rock.

onFailure.narration: The track crumbles, and your climber slides down. The loop catches a stubby rock instead. It holds.

high_own.narration: The goat sniffs at your plan. The handholds are small, but they are there.
high_own.prompt: Pick your own way and carry the rope over.

onSuccess.narration: You find a staircase of handholds nobody else saw.

onFailure.narration: Dead end. You borrow the goat's route. The goat says nothing, loudly.

high_charm.narration: Beguile is a polite magic. You hold out a hand to the goat.
high_charm.prompt: Charm the goat into leading the way.

onSuccess.narration: The goat sighs and leads. It stops at the right rock and stares until you understand.

onFailure.narration: The goat wanders off to chew something. Luckily, it wanders the right way.

high_lower.narration: The line hangs from the high rock down to the far shelf. You check the knot twice. Wedged in a crack beside it hangs a little tin whistle on a cord, the kind keepers carry. You pocket it for a brave moment.

low.narration: You kneel at the gap. The outer lip creaks like a door that wants oil. The ice by the rock looks narrow but steady. How will you find the safe strip?

low_probe.narration: A stone is lighter than a friend, so the stone goes first.
low_probe.prompt: Test the ice with the rope loop and a stone.

onSuccess.narration: The thin outer edge breaks away. Plop. The ice by the rock holds.

onFailure.narration: The stone skates off. You find the strip with your boot, very slowly.

low_chip.narration: You tap a chip into the ice at every step and listen.
low_chip.prompt: Trust only the chips that ring.

onSuccess.narration: Ring, ring, ring. A trail of chips runs along the rock, all ringing true.

onFailure.narration: Two chips thud. You skip them and follow the ones that ring.

low_mark.narration: You mark the strip with chips of dark stone, like a trail of crumbs through the white. It is one boot wide, but it is there. Halfway along, two old coins peek out of the ice. You pocket them. The goat seems to approve.

brace.narration: The thornguard plants both feet and grips the rope. Now the thornguard is a post, and the rope is a handrail. Everyone else keeps the loose end out of the water.

brace_post.narration: The thornguard leans back to test the post.
brace_post.prompt: Haul the rope tight while the thornguard holds.

onSuccess.narration: The rope sings like a harp string. The post does not budge.

onFailure.narration: The rope sags. You retie it shorter: low, but steady.

brace_rail.narration: The handrail runs along the rock, taut and low. It cannot stop the ice from shifting, but every hand has something to hold. The goat gives it a long look, then looks away.

wing.narration: Wings carry one end of the rope over the gap. Tie it to a sound rock, and everyone has a line to follow. It cannot stop the ice from shifting, though.

wing_tie.narration: Flying is half the job. The other half is a knot.
wing_tie.prompt: Fly the rope over and tie it to the far rock.

onSuccess.narration: Two wingbeats, and the knot is tied before the goat can blink.

onFailure.narration: A gust shoves you sideways. You land short and tie the knot with cold fingers.

wing_rail.narration: The line hums across the gap in the wind. The goat watches it politely, as if it were a new kind of weather.

who_first.narration: Your way across is ready. Someone has to try it first and tie the rope on the far side. Everyone looks at everyone else. Nobody looks at the river. Who goes?

first_light.narration: Your quickest hero takes the rope end and goes. Tip, tap, tip. They reach the far rock, tie on and wave both arms.

first_strong.narration: Your strongest hero takes the rope end and goes. It is not far. It only feels far. On the far rock, the rope gets a knot like a fist.

first_dart.narration: You are always gone before trouble arrives. One breath, and whoosh! You are over before the ice notices. The far end is tied, and the others cheer.

gear.narration: Your first crosser waits on the far rock. The packs are still on this side, heavy with wet-weather things. How will you get them over?

gear_slide.narration: You clip the packs to the line. They zoom across like little sleds. The last one lands with a soggy clank.

gear_carry.narration: Every pack has its own weight, and its own opinion about it. Step by wobbly step, they all go over. Somebody sings to one pack to keep it calm. It works.

ready.narration: Your packs are over, and your first crosser waits on the far rock. The line is tight. The river chuckles underneath. This is the crossing. How will you do it?

cross.narration: Under the line, the river chuckles, as if it knows a joke.
cross.prompt: Cross together on the same count, one hand on the line.

onSuccess.narration: You reach the far rock and hold the line for the last friend.

onFailure.narration: A crack runs beneath the shelf. You keep hold of the rope as the ice tips.

cross_turns.narration: One at a time is slower, but everyone gets a breath.
cross_turns.prompt: Cross one at a time, each holding the line for the next.

onSuccess.narration: One by one you cross. The last friend lands on dry rock, grinning.

onFailure.narration: A crack runs beneath the shelf. You keep hold of the rope as the ice tips.

assisted.narration: The rope will help. Just keep it clear of the broken edge.
assisted.prompt: Keep the loose rope clear while the party crosses.

onSuccess.narration: You guide the rope past the broken edge. Every friend reaches the far rock.

onFailure.narration: The line holds, but the shelf beneath you breaks away.

cross_whistle.narration: One loud note, and everyone knows when to step. The goat leaps up and stares.
cross_whistle.prompt: Everyone steps out on the whistle's note, one hand on the line.

onSuccess.narration: Toot! Every boot lands on the note.

onFailure.narration: The note startles the ice. A crack runs beneath the shelf. You keep hold of the rope as it tips.

across.narration: You haul the rope onto dry stone. Ahead, cairns climb toward a notch in the peaks. A griffin on the ridge lifts a wing hello. On the first cairn, a chalked sign hangs over an iron box: HONEYCAKE, 2 COINS. PAY IN THE TIN. Behind you, the gap looks much smaller.

tally.narration: Everybody is here. Everybody is also wet, cold and wobbly in the knees. What do you need before the climb?

tally_warm.narration: You rub each other's hands until they tingle. Someone finds a squashed sticky bun and splits it into very small, very fair pieces.

tally_buy.narration: Two coins clink into the tin. The ridge griffin reaches down, lifts out a honeycake wrapped in a leaf and hands it over. It is still warm. Nobody knows how. Nobody asks.

tally_rope.narration: You coil the rope in neat loops. It still smells of fish, which makes it feel like an old friend. You check every knot twice.

tally_mend.narration: Mend hums warm through your hands. Scrapes close, and the cold leaves your shoulders like water from a sponge. The others stare at their knuckles, then at you.

rest_safe.narration: You sit above the water and retie your packs. The path rises toward the cairns of the Cairnstep. Back on the rocks, the goat gives up on you and goes back to chewing.

fall.narration: The shelf slides into the river, with all of you still on the line. Nobody lets go. Cold water lifts you off the ice and carries you around the bend, rope and all.

fall_vote.narration: You are in the Great River, and it is very cold. The rope is still in your hands, with everyone on it. What matters most right now?

fall_hold.narration: You hold the line, and the line holds you. Hands squeeze along it, one after another. Everyone is here.

fall_look.narration: You gulp air and lift your head. The east bank slides past, too far to reach yet. Dark rock rises above it. Somewhere ahead, the river might let you out.

rest_river.narration: You keep your heads up and hold the line between you. Orin's words come back: do not fight the river under the shelf. Let it carry you, and watch for a way out. You have lost nothing but your footing.

ring_throw.narration: You swing the loop in a slow circle. Drop it over the ring, and the wall gets a handrail. The ring is small. The loop is floppy.

interaction.cue: Tap when the loop is over the ring.

onSuccess.narration: Flup! The loop snugs tight over the ring.

onFailure.narration: The loop flops against the rock. You tie it on by hand. The clumsy knot holds.

onAssisted.narration: Together you guide the loop over the ring. Flup. It holds.

drip_run.narration: The drips plink in a steady rhythm. Wait for the gap, then go.

interaction.cue: Wait for the gold gap, then tap to go.

onSuccess.narration: Plink, plink, dart! One icicle gives a long, sad plink.

onFailure.narration: A drip lands on a hat with a cold plop. Everyone scrambles through.

onAssisted.narration: Together you count the drips out loud, and everyone slips through on the gap.

hold_line.narration: The line sags in the middle. Hold the near end while a friend hauls in the slack.

interaction.cue: Hold the line firm while your friend hauls in the slack.

onSuccess.narration: Tight as a harp string. Pluck it, and it hums.

onFailure.narration: The slack wins at first. A bigger knot holds, but the line hangs low.

onAssisted.narration: Together you wedge the end behind a rock. The line goes tight.

level_line.narration: Before anyone steps out, the line must hang level. Raise or lower your end until it runs straight.

interaction.cue: Raise or lower your end until the line is level.

onSuccess.narration: Straight and level as a ruler.

onFailure.narration: Still a little crooked. You tie it off. It will do.

onAssisted.narration: Together you rest the middle on a lump of rock, and the line hangs level.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, funny, curious, with real consequences. Describe actions and sensory details directly. Short dialogue. Never use "the kind of thing that", "the sort of thing that", or "it was X, the type of thing that makes you Y" comparisons. Let a character act instead of explaining how the reader should feel.
voiceGuide.vocabulary: Read aloud to an eight-year-old. Concrete words, short sentences, distinct voices.
